children: Perella Weinberg Partners filed a prospectus supplement to permit resale of 1,127,529 Class A common shares by certain stockholders.
Prospectus supplement filed to Form S-3ASR (File No. 333-289189) to cover resale from time to time of 1,127,529 Class A shares.
Resale registration facilitates liquidity for certain stockholders and potential market supply of the Company’s Class A common stock.
Legal opinion from Mayer Brown LLP regarding legality of the Shares is attached as Exhibit 5.1 to the filing.
